answer_1.quote: In this paper, we investigated the ability of large language models to answer questions in a long-form manner through two question answering datasets: ASQA and AQuAMuSe... We also evaluate on query-focused multi-document summarization.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our long-form answers using ROUGE (measuring stylistic similarity to gold answers; and reading comprehension models (measuring correctness; ... We also report ROUGE‑1/2/L and QAEval_r for AQuAMuSe.
automatic_metrics: DR (Geometric mean of ROUGE‑L and D‑F1)

answer_4.quote: We conducted human evaluation on 50 randomly selected outputs of PaLM best (prompt tuning using the full dataset), T5 best (open‑book fine‑tuning 5 passages), and PaLM few‑shot... We asked three expert annotators (1) to mark each output if it has fluency issues and (2) to classify among the outputs which is the best/worst in terms of (2.a) their preference on how the question is disambiguated and (2.b) its similarity to the gold answer.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators marked fluency errors and performed best‑worst scaling for disambiguation preference and similarity to the gold answer.
